question: Which release keyword argument is required for from_parts?
actual:
[26.3 · packaging-version-reference · from_parts] Return a new version composed of the various parts.

This allows you to build a version without going though a string and
running a regular expression. It normalizes pre-release strings. The
``release=`` keyword argument is required.

>>> Version.from_parts(release=(1,2,3))
<Version('1.2.3')>
>>> Version.from_parts(release=(0,1,0), pre=("b", 1))
<Version('0.1.0b1')>

:param epoch:
:param release: This version tuple is required

.. versionadded:: 26.1

question: What are the release components?
actual:
[25.0 · packaging-version-reference · release] The components of the "release" segment of the version.

>>> Version("1.2.3").release
(1, 2, 3)
>>> Version("2.0.0").release
(2, 0, 0)
>>> Version("1!2.0.0.post0").release
(2, 0, 0)

Includes trailing zeroes but not the epoch or any pre-release / development /
post-release suffixes.
